The Warrens is the capital of kobold civilization in the Ringing Deeps. The settlement is on the east-central wall of the zone, bordered by the Chittering Den to the southeast, the Shadowvein Extraction Site to the southwest, and the Lost Mines to the northwest. Players are first directed here during the Manifesto Destiny quest in the Ringing Deeps storyline. The Chittering Concourse skyriding race is at just to the southeast.

Watchmaster Leonar is an Ascended kyrian located in Bastion. He was part of the grand reception the Archon arranged for a Maw Walker, who decided to join the Kyrian Covenant, in honor of their efforts against the Maldraxxus incursion in Bastion. When members of the Venthyr Covenant sought the aid of Forgelite Prime Mikanikos to craft the Crown of the Harvesters he could be found at the Eternal Forge apparently in charge of its defense. Later Leonar alongside his Forge Defenders held of the Forsworn forces while the crown was being completed.

Watcher Toki is an earthen located in Gundargaz in the Ringing Deeps. During the war in Khaz Algar, Toki was dealing with kobold raids on the town. When adventurers arrived in the town with Brinthe, she was introduced to them and was glad to see Brinthe. When she was working on clearing monsters from the town's outskirts, Innkeeper Brax was helping her. She sent the newly arrived adventurers to kill The Ringing Death and to locate the source of disapearance of her workers, which turned out to be a Daughter of Alizabal, a demon that had escaped from Dalaran. Later, she traveled to Ironforge alongside Vokmar and other earthen after High Speaker Brinthe asked her to serve as an ambassador.

Water-Resistant Receipt is found at in the back of the silithid-filled cave of the Sunken Dig Site in Thousand Needles. The receipt can only be interacted with after picking up the Sandy Ransom Note from Alyx's call board at the celebration area outside the Caverns of Time in Tanaris as part of Guest Relations. The title previously belonged to Vashti the Wandering Merchant in Azsuna who sold decidedly non-exotic wares, so he now bears the title. Vashti patrols the eastern road, likely at the southern end around in the Olivian Veil. In addition to his normal wares, Vashti has several new purchases, including the Sandy Celebration Crate!
